summary: First compare against the routed netlist (the reference the #109 analysis named as the remaining hypothesis: 'an LVS run against a reference that is the netlist the layout implements'). Verdict: mismatch, exit 3 - the grade is unchanged and the residue barely moved: nets matched 408 (r12, against design/netlist/slice_asap7.v: 352), net.split 15269 (r12 15331), net.merged 14967 (r12 15246), device.unmatched 55444 (r12 56195), hints.rejected 67. tracing.what: With the different-netlist hypothesis refuted, the residue was traced on the committed stream (predictive-model tool results only; analysis of committed files plus one klt extract run and one throwaway-uvx klayout measurement, both reworked after r13 review). Cell-internal extraction is correct: the r9 single-cell probe still stands, a two-instance abutment probe (two R0 BUFx4_ASAP7_75t_R at exact abutment, one local klt lvs run under the same pinned klt) leaves the cells' internal AN nets separate, and klt extract on the routed stream reproduces every library cell's CDL topology hierarchically. REWORKED AFTER REVIEW (2026-11-15): the extract and geometry figures first published in this block were measured by uncommitted scratch scripts and did not survive reproduction; they are replaced below by measurements whose scripts, intermediate artifacts and outputs are committed here.
tracing.extract: uvx --with klayout --from klayout-tools==0.9.1 klt extract layout/slice_routed.gds --deck asap7 --top slice (exit 0; netlist committed as evidence/item4-lvs/slice_routed.r13.extract.v, SPICE X-card form; the run warns that three layers (3/251 88 shapes, 100/0 92, 235/5 1) are outside the deck's connectivity graph). Top circuit: 2594 X instances and 2955 nets. Counted by the committed script evidence/item4-lvs/slice_routed.r13.refnets.py (output evidence/item4-lvs/slice_routed.r13.refnets.json; the counting domain is stated in its docstring: cell pins are instance connections - SPICE X-card nodes or Verilog instance port connections - module ports are not cell pins, and vector declarations expand to one net per bit): the extract has 199 nets with exactly one cell pin, all top-level port bits, against 198 in layout/slice_routed.v (likewise all port bits); 1801 nets with exactly two cell pins, equal to the reference's 1801; rx_clk reaches 528 cell pins, equal to the reference's 528. The review's independent parse of the committed reference (2594 instances, 528 rx_clk pins, 198 one-cell-pin nets, 1801 two-cell-pin nets) is reproduced by the committed script exactly. The figures first published in this block - 855 extract one-pin nets, rx_clk reaching 179 pins, 6/1649 reference figures - were not reproducible and are withdrawn; both sides now come from the committed counter, and the extract netlist itself is committed so every figure is checkable.
tracing.geometry: The 'one connected web' finding first published here was an artifact of the measurement, reworked after review: the fill joined the M2-M6 metal layers wherever they overlap - a plain 2D union - and the joins were never through via cuts. The committed script evidence/item4-lvs/slice_routed.r13.trace_geometry.py (output evidence/item4-lvs/slice_routed.r13.trace_geometry.json; klayout LayoutToNetlist engine - the same engine klt lvs extracts with - flattened, top circuit slice; klayout module 0.30.13, the same module as the r13 LVS run, still flagged against the 0.30.12 this klt build was tested against) measures both connectivities on the committed stream: metals-union (M2-M6 pairwise-conducted on geometric overlap) yields 233 components with the largest holding 99.397 percent of the stack's routing area at bbox (0,4696)-(95340,176744) dbu, reproducing the published die-spanning web and its 99.3 percent (the published 215-component count came from the uncommitted scratch union; 233 is this script's count of the same connectivity; merged-layer counts reproduce the original observation exactly - M2 14361, M3 7850). Via-aware connectivity (M2-V2-M3-V3-M4-V4-M5-V5-M6, two metals conducting only where a via cut joins them) yields 5485 components with the largest holding 2.95 percent of the routing area (166.7e6 of 5649.6e6 dbu^2, areas summed per layer, crossings not deduplicated) at bbox (29428,4696)-(95340,176744) dbu: strap-scale, not die-spanning. The review's independent via-aware measurement (3949 components, largest 2.99 percent) agrees qualitatively; the count difference is implementation detail (this script pre-merges each layer's region and wires no extra joins). Sanity assertion recorded per the review's process note: the via layers change the component count, so the via-aware fill is via-mediated - and conversely, the published count surviving removal of the via layers is what proved the original fill never consulted them.
tracing.m2_width: Withdrawn. The 'sub-minimum-width M2 shapes' first published here are the stream's uniform M2 drawn width: all 14361 merged M2 polygons on the committed stream have minimum dimension exactly 72 dbu = 0.018 um (the ASAP7 M2 drawn width at 1x, dbu 0.00025 um), and 162 of them are identical 87048 x 72 dbu strap shapes. No width anomaly exists; a genuine width violation would also be a DRC error, and item 3's record shows none of this class.
tracing.conclusion: No determined cause. The three trace-level hypotheses examined between r5 and r13 are closed: (a) the layout implements a different netlist than the reference - refuted by the r13 grade itself, since this stream was routed from layout/slice_routed.v and still mismatches; (b) the M2-M6 routing is one shorted web - refuted, it was the 2D-union artifact above; via-aware connectivity shows an ordinary routed stack; (c) top-level extraction collapses into one-pin fragments - not supported by the committed extract and counter, whose per-net pin distribution matches the reference closely. What remains is the r5-r13 net.split/net.merged/device.unmatched residue with no measured cause; the next step is a per-net diff of the extracted circuit against the reference, or attribution inside the place-and-route flow. Nothing here implies an LVS, deck or option change (decision 0005 intact).
